missed.why: P2 did not consider the precision window supervisors (TPS3703, TPS3702). This part narrows the unspecified band from P2's 169 mV to 153.5 mV. Source: TPS3703-Q1 data sheet SBVS344D (March 2021), https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps3703-q1.pdf, read 2026-09-28T18:20:28Z. It carries the same figures as TPS3703 SBVS249B, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps3703.pdf, read 18:18:47Z. Naming (SBVS249B Table 12-1): A = window with CT open 10 ms; 7 = UV and OV at -7 % and +7 %; 330 = 3.30 V nominal. So VIT-(UV) nominal is 3.069 V. Electrical characteristics at -40 to 125 degC: threshold accuracy +/-0.7 %, so the threshold is 3.0475 V to 3.0905 V. VHYS is 0.3 % to 0.8 % of the tripoint, so the release is at most 3.0905 x 1.008 = 3.115 V, below 3.201 V. The band from 3.0475 V to 3.201 V is 153.5 mV. The threshold minimum is above 2.0 V (74HC423), and also above the 3.0 V operating minimum of the MC14538B. The OV trip is 3.531 V -0.7 % = 3.506 V minimum, above 3.399 V, so it does not assert inside the rail tolerance. Above 3.506 V it also asserts RESET; that is the disabling direction. tD is 7 ms to 13 ms with CT open, which meets V43's 125 ns. VDD 1.7 V to 5.5 V. RESET is driven low below UVLO (1.2 V to 1.7 V). VPOR is 1 V max. The output is open-drain, so it needs a pull-up, as P2's rank 1 does. JLCPCB C1849519: stockCount 307, canPresaleNumber 305 (2026-09-28T18:19:39Z, vendors.py jlcpcb C1849519); the gate is 50. TI product page https://www.ti.com/product/TPS3703-Q1: status ACTIVE, and the orderable TPS3703A7330DSERQ1 is listed (read 18:20:16Z). No second source is shown. The non-Q1 TPS3703A7330DSER (C2861206) has JLCPCB 23, presale 19 (18:19:40Z), under the gate. TPS3703A5330 (band 88 mV) and A6330 (C2868050, C2862900) have JLCPCB 0 (18:19:42Z, 18:19:43Z). A4330 fails the release rule: 3.168 x 1.007 x 1.008 = 3.216 V. Digi-Key was not read: the API answered HTTP 429, daily rate limit exceeded (2026-09-28T18:20:05Z). TPS3702AX33 would give a 127 mV band but has JLCPCB 6 (18:19:48Z) and no reset delay.

P2 did not consider isolated switch drivers. The gate supply comes from the 3.3 V primary, not from the pack, so the part closes the array at any pack voltage, the 2.8 V of V51 included. Source: TPSI3050 SLVSGO9C (August 2023), https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tpsi3050.pdf, read 2026-09-28T18:21:31Z; TPSI3050-Q1 SLVSFJ7D, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tpsi3050-q1.pdf, read 18:20:39Z. Three-wire mode: VDDP 3.0 V to 5.5 V. VDRV is 9.4 V to 11 V, a floating 10 V gate drive held with EN high (standard enable, 100 % duty). Peak drive is 1.5 A source and 3.0 A sink. tHL_VDRV (EN falling to VDRV at 10 %) is 2.5 us typ, 3 us max, well inside 5 ms. tLH_VDRV is 3 us typ, 4.5 us max. On loss of VDDP, VDRV goes low in 100 us typ, and an active clamp keeps VDRV under 2 V: fail-open with the 3.3 V supply absent. VIOWM is 1414 VDC. EN in three-wire mode is 0 V to 5.5 V (absolute maximum 60 V). No I_off and no internal EN pull-down are stated, so the 4.7 kOhm series route of IOBoard.md:192 and an external pull-down apply. There is no register in the path. A closed MOSFET array conducts both ways (V47). CDIV sizing: at least 20 x the gate capacitance switched, 40 uF maximum each (section 9.2.2.3). The closing time at the array's gate charge against V46 is not computed here. JLCPCB: C17227641 stockCount 2036, presale 1981; C17341959 stockCount 2973, presale 2973 (2026-09-28T18:21:20Z). TPSI3052DWZR (C20346001, 15 V gate, same DWZ package) has 1126, presale 1107 (18:21:21Z). The TI product pages TPSI3050 and TPSI3050-Q1 show status ACTIVE (18:20:19Z). Unlike the LTC7001, the DWZR and QDWZRQ1 are rule-5 alternates of each other in one land. Digi-Key was not read (HTTP 429, 18:20:05Z).

It gives the floating gate drive that the 2N7002 parts cannot. The drive does not depend on the pack voltage, so the module closes at a 2.8 V pack (V51). Figures as in the onboard pack switch driver entry (SLVSGO9C read 2026-09-28T18:21:31Z; SLVSFJ7D read 18:20:39Z): 10 V VDRV, 3 A sink, 3 us max from EN falling. The gate load is 5 x VS-FC420SA10 at Qg 375 nC typ, 1.875 uC at 10 V. That is about 190 nF equivalent, which needs CDIV of about 3.8 uF series by the 20x rule, inside the 40 uF limit. This is derived, not stated. Stock as in that entry (18:21:20Z). With the TPSI3050 on both the onboard and the external paths, the board no longer rests on the LTC7001, which has JLCPCB 62 and no second source.

exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: characteristics given at VDD 5 V, 10 V and 15 V only, so K at 3.3 V (V36) and the timing-pin leakage (V37) cannot be read for the 3.3 V rail
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: The two halves of the reason fail in different ways. (1) The leakage can be read by the method P2 used for its own rank 1. MC14538B/D Rev. 12 (March 2022, https://www.onsemi.com/download/data-sheet/pdf/mc14538b-d.pdf, read 2026-09-28T18:15:24Z) gives the input current of the timing pin (pin 2 or 14) as +/-0.05 uA max at 25 degC and VDD 15 V, and +/-0.5 uA at 125 degC. Doubled every 10 degC to 50 degC that is 0.28 uA. P2's V37 for the 74HC423 also uses a figure read at another supply: the +/-0.1 uA limit at VCC 6.0 V, giving 0.57 uA. (2) K: the requirement P2 wrote says a term the datasheet does not state is reported, not estimated. P2 keeps the 74HC423 with its K temperature term unstated, and P4 refuted it in T2 on that ground. The MC14538B graphs K against temperature (Fig. 8, VDD 5 V, Rx 100 kOhm, Cx 0.1 uF, typical). Read from the page at 110 dpi, with a resolution of about 0.2 %, K changes by about 0.5 % from 0 to 50 degC. Neither Fig. 6 (supply, 5 V to 15 V) nor Fig. 8 reaches 3.3 V. So both parts have an unstated K term; an unstated term does not separate them. What does separate them: the MC14538B's lowest characterized supply is 5 V, above the 3.3 V rail, where the 74HC423's 2.0 V to 6.0 V columns bracket it. The MC14538B's VIH is stated only at 5 V (3.5 V min), so the trigger-high-level requirement (VIH at 3.3 V at or below 3.15 V) is not shown for it. If the exclusion rests on that ground, it holds; as worded, it does not. Its '423 behaviour is stated (function table: Reset rising, 'Not Triggered'). The stock passes: JLCPCB C57398 stockCount 6796, presale 6761 (18:16:48Z). A same-die alternate exists: MC14538BDTR2G (C464017) stockCount 394, presale 393 (18:16:48Z). Its 3.0 V operating minimum sits below the supervisor thresholds (3.032 V for TPS3808G33, 3.0475 V for TPS3703A7330).

exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: not qualified: unused preset needs its own pull-up and preset and clear both low drive both outputs high; the '175 parts pass every requirement with fewer inputs; datasheets not read in this task
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: No latch requirement fails on these grounds. Nexperia 74LVC1G74 Rev. 18 (22 September 2025, https://assets.nexperia.com/documents/data-sheet/74LVC1G74.pdf, read 2026-09-28T18:25:46Z) states 'Schmitt-trigger action at all inputs' and IOFF +/-2 uA at VI or VO 5.5 V, VCC 0 V, the same limit as the 74LVC1G175. Table 4 gives SD L with RD L as Q H and nQ H. With SD tied to VCC, that row cannot occur, and the tie needs no pull-up. The reasons are a preference for the 6-pin part. The outcome likely stays the same: it is an 8-pin VSSOP, not a rule-5 alternate in the '175 land. It is not excluded on a requirement.
